newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Radex sees higher earnings in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Radex sees higher earnings in 1997.

text.p: Austrian industrial group Radex-Heraklith Industriebeteiligungs AG (RHI) on Wednesday forecast net and pre-tax earnings would rise this year against a background of moderate sales growth.
"RHI expects a further improvement in return on sales, pre-tax profit and net profit this year with slightly higher sales," the firm said in a statement released ahead of a news conference.

Radex posted a net profit of 582 million schillings last year, up from 467 million in 1995, while pre-tax profit rose to 674 million from 577. Sales slipped to 21 billion schillings from 21.7 billion.

The firm said higher earnings this year would come from an improved product mix and cost cutting. Radex said it planned to restructure its engineering division and improve profitability in fireproof materials and insulation by cutting costs and developing new products.

"Based on the planned measures and our ambitious goals for 1997, we are confident of taking a big step towards our mid-term aims of high group profitability and an attractive RHI share," chief executive Walter Ressler said. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
